svg.title: Economy shocks: drought, fire and war (1,000 residents, 365 days, seed 1)
svg.desc: Two panels over days: essential-goods fulfilment for each shock scenario, and the worst district's fulfilment in each, so a shock's dip and its recovery are visible side by side.
